$comment: Conformance cases for distance to a route polyline and for a step crossing the exit segment. The definitions are the place terms in scenario-parameters.schema.json (checks) and specs/scenarios/walk-hallway/README.md (Places, not axes). Distances are in the floor plane. The first leg extends backward past the route start and the last leg extends forward past the route end, so a point past an end is measured sideways. A single leg is that line in both directions. The interior end of a leg is not extended, so the legs do not extend through a corner. Cutting an inside corner uses the nearer leg. Outside a corner, overshoot is measured from the vertex, so at a right-angle corner the distance is stricter than the walls by up to √2; for a turn of φ the factor is 1 / cos(φ/2). A step crosses when the first sample is strictly before the exit line and the second sample is on or past it, on the side the route's last leg points toward, and that second sample is within half the segment's length of the exit reference along the segment, endpoints included. The point where the step meets the line is not tested. A step that starts already on or past the line does not cross again. On the straight hallway-open route, lateral distance is |y| and a forward step crosses at x >= 3 with |y| <= 0.75 at the second sample. On this L-shaped route the last leg points +y, so a forward step crosses at y >= 3 with |x| <= 0.75 at the second sample. The numbers below are those closed forms, checked by hand. tooling/world-layout.mjs and the Python package both have to match them.

distances.name: lateral equals |y| on the other side

crossings.name: meeting point on the endpoint, second sample is outside
crossings.because: meets (3, 0.75); second sample is at y = 1.5

crossings.name: meeting point outside the segment, second sample is inside
crossings.because: meets (3, 1); second sample is at y = 0

crossings.name: one centimetre step, second sample is inside
crossings.because: meeting y is past 0.75; second sample y = 0.7495

crossings.name: one centimetre step, second sample is outside
crossings.because: meeting y is within 0.75; second sample y = 0.7505

crossings.name: meeting point inside the segment, second sample is outside
crossings.because: meets (3, 0); second sample is at y = 1

distances.name: outside the corner, nearer the last leg
beyond the corner, first leg is not extended forward
below the corner, last leg is not extended backward
tie at the corner from both legs

crossings.name: meeting point on the endpoint, second sample is outside
crossings.because: meets (0.75, 3); second sample is at x = 1.5

crossings.name: meeting point outside the segment, second sample is inside
crossings.because: meets (1, 3); second sample is at x = 0
